Round180G.uniform_projected_jet_cost.{u_1} {H : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
  (G : Submodule ℂ H) [G.HasOrthogonalProjection] (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) f) (hs : HasCompactSupport f) :
  ∃ R,
    1 ≤ R ∧
      (∀ (j : ℕ), Integrable (iteratedDeriv j f) volume) ∧
        ∀ (N : ℕ) (alpha : ℝ),
          0 ≤ alpha →
            ∀ (z : ℂ),
              |z.re| ≤ alpha →
                ∀ (r n : ℕ) (eta : ℕ → H ⧸ G →L[ℂ] ℂ) (psi : ℕ → H ⧸ G),
                  have c := fun i => (-1) ^ r * ∫ (x : ℝ), ↑x ^ (i + r) * f x * Complex.exp (z * ↑x);
                  have D := ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ↑(N.choose j) * ∫ (x : ℝ), ‖iteratedDeriv (N - j) f x‖;
                  have C := Real.exp (alpha * R) * (R ^ (n + r) * (↑(n + r) + 1) ^ N * D);
                  (S G).comp ((block n eta c psi).comp (Q G)) =
                      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, ((jetAction eta c m).comp (Q G)).smulRight ((S G) (psi m)) ∧
                    ‖z‖ ^ N * ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, ‖(jetAction eta c m).comp (Q G)‖ * ‖(S G) (psi m)‖ ≤
                      C * conditionedCost G n eta psi fun x => 1
